description: Convert an .aab into an installable APK with bundletool (cached in .swipium/artifacts/) before qa_prepare_target. Default: a universal APK; connectedDevice:true builds a device APK set, install:true installs it (consent-gated). Runs as a job.

aab.description: Default: the best .aab in the project.

device.description: adb serial (default: session device, else SWIPIUM_DEVICE, else the only one).

install.description: With connectedDevice: install-apks on the device (consent-gated).

name: qa_bundletool
title: Convert .aab > installable .apk
